=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1822-1829 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: When no other waiter remains, the tick unlabels a skip-held PR and sends it back through the review flow, allowing the update-mode gate to grant it the lease on the same head.
  WHY: The gate filters the skip-listed caller from the queue but proceeds when no different waiter is returned, then writes a held lease that drops that PR's skip entry, so the PR can reacquire the lease without changing its head, contrary to the skip-until-head-changes requirement (reviewer stated SEVERITY: MAJOR; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 analysed this path and reported no defect, stating the tick never grants that waiter so D4 holds).
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1828 | severity=unspecified | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Unquoted word splitting of tick_skip_held_prs in `for tick_skip_pr in ${tick_skip_held_prs}` may call _merge_lease_unlabel_wait with an empty argument.
  WHY: If the space-separated string is empty or has stray spaces, the label delete would target an invalid API path and could cause label-management failures (the reviewer stated no severity; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 disputes it because unquoted splitting drops empty fields and entries are validated against `^[1-9][0-9]*$`; minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash also note the regex validation, and minimax rates it hardening only).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
